cli_help.stdout:
usage: run_cpu_reference.py [-h] {prepare,smoke} ...

Prepare the pinned C FP32 embedding runtime, or save a small CPU smoke anchor.
All inference, tokenization and preprocessing run in upstream C. PyTorch is
used only by `prepare` to read/export the checkpoint. No CUDA/NPU runtime is
imported by `smoke`. Upstream: howard-hou/EmbeddingRWKV, Apache-2.0.

positional arguments:
  {prepare,smoke}
    prepare        Export weights and build the C library; no inference
    smoke          Save CPU FP32 comparison artifacts for fixed cases

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
